This photo shows leftovers after a meal, so I'm estimating only the food still visible.

- Plate at upper left: wrapped flatbread or tortilla scraps, about 40 g, roughly 120 kcal.
- Plate at lower left: a few fried or breaded pieces, about 30 g, roughly 90 kcal.
- Center plate: sauce residue and a bit of lettuce, about 25 g, roughly 50 kcal.
- Small cups: dressing and sauce remnants, about 10 g, roughly 15 kcal.
- Bowl at right: almost empty, so negligible.

That gives about 105 g of food and about 275 kcal.
